hypothesis: Fresh ODS scalar row creation can avoid retaining the full worksheet model, content XML, and output package by consuming rows into one bounded audited XML fragment window and a sequential non-seek sink.
classification: Necessary bounded-memory capability enabler with matched existing-builder measurements; no logical existing-document append claim.
timing_scope: Create deterministic scalar row inputs, author content, validate publication, compress/finalize package, and write to hashing discard sink. Exclude artifact creation/reopen oracle, procfs probes, sink construction and digest extraction.
preservation_scope: Fresh one-sheet scalar documents only; no existing source or unknown content is modified.
comparison_scope: Matched semantic rows and cells, not necessarily identical XML/package lexical representation. Full-byte hashes must be stable within each implementation.
allocator_policy: serialized_region_peak_v3; derive peak minus entry; normal binaries own latency claims; process maximum RSS includes setup and oracle.
shape_revision_reason: Existing PackageWriter authored XML default permits 250000 aggregate attributes. The 131072-row proposal would require more than this. The matched large shape is 32768 rows; no production limit is relaxed.
